ModMetaData.name: Better Medicine
ModMetaData.author: 9ranr11d
ModMetaData.description:
Renamed from "Doctor Work Split". If the mod shows as disabled after the update, re-enable it in the mod list. A one-time "missing mod" warning when loading a save is harmless.
Small medical improvements. XML only, no DLL.
Doctor work split Splits the Doctor work type into three columns on the Work tab. - Doctor: emergency and routine treatment, self-tending, animal treatment, rescue - Surgery: operations on people and animals, taking patients to bed for operations - Patient care: feeding patients and animals, administering hemogen, visiting the sick Paramedic mechs keep all three kinds of work. Existing colonists start with the two new columns off. If [FSF] Complex Jobs is active, this work split turns itself off (Complex Jobs already has Surgeon and Nurse).
Bionic nose Adds a bionic nose, made at the fabrication bench (Bionics research) like other bionic parts and installed by surgery on a missing nose. The pawn no longer counts as disfigured, so others stop giving the -15 opinion penalty.
Works with existing saves. If you remove the mod, installed bionic noses disappear.
Formerly "Doctor Work Split".
